name: remotion-sisyphus
description: 野马效应 · 横屏知识短视频（Remotion，纯代码动画）

scripts.build:preview: npm run check:script && npm run audio && npm run render:preview
scripts.qa:audio: node scripts/synth-audio.mjs --end preview --stems && python3 scripts/qa-audio.py out/preview.mp4 out/audio-qa
scripts.qa:frames: npm run render:textonly && python3 scripts/qa-frames.py out/qa/textonly.mp4 out/preview.mp4 out/qa
scripts.qa:film: npm run render:textonly:film && python3 scripts/qa-frames.py out/qa/textonly_film.mp4 out/film.mp4 out/qa/film && python3 scripts/qa-motion.py out/film.mp4 && node scripts/synth-audio.mjs --end full --stems && python3 scripts/qa-audio.py out/film.mp4 out/audio-qa
